column1: # European Portuguese (pt-PT), shipped in values-pt, the base for every Portuguese phone that is not Brazilian. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.

# percent_style takes no space (85%), as CLDR and NAVEE's Portuguese manual write it. decimal_style is an example of the separators: the group mark is a no-break space (U+00A0), and four-digit numbers take no separator in text (1234,5).
